Operations Bot: :rotating_light: [P1] auth-proxy unusual mirror traffic detected — high POST rate to /v1/auth/token and simultaneous s3-debug forward. Suspect: mirrored debug pipeline. Sample: s3://debug-forwarder/2026/03/18/edge-203_0_113_12.log
Maya (Oncall): acked. I'm on it — will shadow for 15m then escalate if not contained. @Sam @Priya
Sam (SRE): oncall handover received. First action: fence suspect CIDR 203.0.113.0/24 at edge layer, disable debug-forwarder route, and mute non-critical observability alerts. Who can flip the mirror config?
Luis (Eng): I can flip the forwarder. Running dry-run now. Patch: `kubectl -n infra exec debug-forwarder -- curl -X POST http://localhost:9000/admin/disable-forwarding` (will apply in 30s)
Maya (Oncall): +1, please apply and report success. Also block CIDR at WAF and edge ACLs: `edgectl acl add-block 203.0.113.0/24 --reason "suspected-mirror-replay"`
Luis (Eng): applied forwarder disable — response 200. Mirroring stopped, last recorded event at 3603339966. Pushing ACL change to edge (propagation ~30s).
Sam (SRE): confirmed ACL in edge propagated. Observability: auth token egress rate dropped ~98% in the past 45s. Good. Next: assess if any PII or tokens were stored in reachable buckets. @Priya your assessment?
Priya (Security): scanning indexer for public ACLs now. Initial grep for `Authorization:` in debug bucket shows masked tokens but some lines include session fragments. Example (sanitized): ```2026-03-18T10:01:12Z INFO auth request id=abcd user=acct-9876 auth_header="Bearer ***xyz..."``` No full-long-term keys seen so far. Still investigating whether any artifacts were copied externally.
Jordan (CSE): Received a customer message (acct-9876) reporting unusual re-auth prompts starting ~10:00UTC. They haven't seen data leakage claims yet but are asking for timeline.
Maya (Oncall): Customer impact likely moderate (session reauth). Prioritize rotation plan for service tokens that could be in debug logs. We should prepare a customer bridge note. Recommended: rotate affected service keys, rotate session signing keys, and prepare targeted notification to acct-9876.
Sam (SRE): Agreed. Plan: (1) rotate debug-forwarder service credentials immediately (2) rotate session signing key v1 -> v2 with hot-swap (3) run revocation for sessions created between 10:00-10:15UTC and issue short-lived replacement. Estimated ETA: 30m for rotation, 45m for revocation sweep.
Priya (Security): I'll own rotation audit and provide signed rotation log. Commands I'll run: `redwoodctl keys rotate --service debug-forwarder --rotate-credentials` and `redwoodctl keys rotate --service auth-session --hot-swap --notify-systems`. Will attach proof artifacts.
Luis (Eng): Implementing rotation for forwarder creds now. Will coordinate with Maya for service restart window. Minimal impact expected, can be done with no-customer-downtime.
Maya (Oncall): Jordan please draft a short proactive note to acct-9876: 1) we're investigating anomalous auth forwarding, 2) we've stopped the forwarder, 3) rotating service/session keys, 4) no confirmed data exfiltration at this time, 5) we'll follow up within 2 hours with details. Send via secure channel once I approve.
Jordan (CSE): Draft ready in #customers-dm. Ping me when approved.
Legal Bot: Notify legal for potential disclosure? Recommend collecting retention window and sampling logs. Legal on standby.
Priya (Security): Collected list of objects that had auth fragments; none were public ACL. Will run MD5 and access logs to trace external GETs since 09:50UTC.
Sam (SRE): Handoff summary for next shift: incident id INC-3603337, actions taken: forwarder disabled, edge ACL blocked 203.0.113.0/24, forwarder creds rotation started, session key hot-swap planned, customer acct-9876 notified draft pending. Oncall team to monitor for 2h for any resumed egress or new 401/refresh spikes.
Maya (Oncall): handing off to night SRE @Sam (SRE) in 15m. I'll remain reachable. If anything resurfaces escalate to PagerDuty SIRT. :+1:
Sam (SRE): taking handoff. I'll run full revocation sweep and confirm when complete. Save artifacts to secure S3 path: s3://redwood-secure/incidents/INC-3603337/
Priya (Security): rotation complete for debug-forwarder creds at 3603340145. Session key hot-swap success at 3603340188. Revocation sweep started (approx 15k sessions scanned).
Maya (Oncall): closing active pager once revocation sweep completes and customer note is posted. Thanks all for fast responses.
Jordan (CSE): Customer note approved and sent at 3603340190 over secure channel. Planning 1:1 bridge if they request.
Sam (SRE): revocation sweep complete, no sign of external object reads. All mitigations completed. Closing bridge and filing incident report.
Operations Bot: Incident INC-3603337 status -> mitigated. Timeline and artifacts stored at s3://redwood-secure/incidents/INC-3603337/report.json
